Name: Challenging Slime Egg Bundles
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[size=3]If you're tired of the same old bundles, or want a different kind of challenge, try [color=#00ff00]Slime Egg Bundles[/color]! This mod will task you to not only [color=#00ff00]slay slimes[/color] to get their...well, their [color=#00ff00]slime[/color], but to [color=#00ff00]press them into eggs[/color] too! You will need one of each color slime egg ([color=#93c47d]green[/color], [color=#cc0000]red[/color], [color=#1e84cc]blue[/color], [color=#8e7cc3]purple[/color]) for each bundle. Fear not, you won't have to get to combat level 6 to start these bundles; Marlon will [color=#00ff00]sell you[/color] the [color=#00ff00]Slime Egg-Press[/color] for the awfully [color=#00ff00]generous[/color] price of [color=#00ff00]20,000g[/color]! And if you need some extra help, Marlon will also [color=#00ff00]sell slime[/color] for the [color=#00ff00]equally generous[/color] price of [color=#00ff00]1[/color][color=#00ff00]5g[/color]! Remember, these bundles are meant to be a different type of challenge!! 
All rewards [color=#00ff00]remain the same[/color].

This mod will only work in a [color=#00ff00]NEW SAVE[/color], it will[color=#00ff00] not[/color] appear in a current save!

Please enjoy the slimey eggy bundles, and let me know if you have any questions, concerns, or suggestions and feedback![/size]
